relationship_to_geometry_protocol.role: additive orthogonal RGB heldout measurement suite

input_binding.image_transform: none; decode the exact frozen COLMAP-undistorter JPEG bytes without resize, crop, pad, re-encode, or EXIF transpose

prediction_contract.camera_source: the same frozen native-quarter COLMAP cameras, or a predeclared method-coordinate copy related by the method's frozen training similarity transform only
prediction_contract.render_source: each method's frozen official inference renderer and frozen formal checkpoint
prediction_contract.heldout_rgb_renderer_boundary: direct camera adapters never load heldout RGB; Graphdeco-family loaders may decode it while constructing Camera objects but the benchmark adapter must clear original_image before the frozen renderer is called
prediction_contract.background: the method's frozen training background setting; all active 3K recipes use black
prediction_contract.quantization: clip finite float RGB to [0,1], multiply by 255, add 0.5, floor, cast to uint8
prediction_contract.resolution: exact frozen camera width and height

metric_domain.decode: Pillow RGB uint8 decoded to float32 sRGB [0,1]
metric_domain.alpha_handling: predictions must be RGB; alpha is forbidden

PSNR.definition: Graphdeco official full-frame RGB MSE followed by 20*log10(1/sqrt(MSE))
PSNR.exact_match_policy: positive infinity is represented as the string Infinity in JSON and inf in CSV; no arbitrary cap

SSIM.definition: Graphdeco official 11x11 Gaussian-window SSIM, sigma 1.5, zero padding, full-frame RGB mean

LPIPS_VGG.definition: Graphdeco-bundled lpipsPyTorch v0.1 VGG16 path on decoded [0,1] tensors

coverage_and_aggregation.per_scene: unweighted arithmetic mean over all frozen test views
coverage_and_aggregation.cross_scene: unweighted macro mean over complete scenes

appearance_policy.general: no heldout RGB may select, fit, or optimize an appearance or exposure parameter
appearance_policy.metrogs: use the frozen official find_most_similar_cameras rule with alpha=0.7 and copy the selected training camera.idx appearance ID using camera pose only; use_app_time=false and use_app_robust=false
appearance_policy.rade_gs: report the canonical base renderer output; the frozen PGSR-style appearance module only changes the training loss and is neither restored nor fitted on heldout views
appearance_policy.sof: report the deployable canonical renderer output; its decoupled appearance network is training-only and no heldout embedding is fitted
appearance_policy.pgsr_and_gsprior: frozen recipes have exposure_compensation=false; use render, never app_image
appearance_policy.citygaussian_v2: the frozen SepDepthTrim2DGSRenderer checkpoint has no appearance module

formal_gate.review_candidate_render_default: reject before creating any artifact path
formal_gate.technical_smoke_exception: requires an explicit allow_review_candidate flag and confines render and metric outputs to an explicit technical_smoke_root
formal_gate.activation_preflight: fresh PASS_READY evidence bound to the exact clean activation commit/tree and current contract/registry hashes
formal_gate.benchmark_checkout_identity: every formal adapter and evaluator rechecks the exact clean benchmark commit and tree
